item.tumultu.shaping_shard.tooltip: Upgrades a Normal item to Magic with 1 random affix.
item.tumultu.growth_shard.tooltip: Adds a new random affix to a Magic item with room for one more.
item.tumultu.heightening_shard.tooltip: Upgrades a Magic item to Rare and adds a random affix.
item.tumultu.infusion_shard.tooltip: Upgrades a Normal item to Rare with up to 6 random affixes.
item.tumultu.cleansing_shard.tooltip: Removes all affixes, returning the item to Normal.
item.tumultu.twisting_shard.tooltip: Rerolls all affixes on a Rare item.
item.tumultu.peaking_shard.tooltip: Adds a new random affix to a Rare item with room for one more.
item.tumultu.severing_shard.tooltip: Removes one random affix from the item.
item.tumultu.weaving_shard.tooltip: Rerolls the numeric values of existing affixes, keeping the same affixes.
item.tumultu.endfusing_shard.tooltip: Corrupts the item with a random, permanent change and locks it from further modification.
item.tumultu.unspoken_promise.tooltip: Place in the crafting bench's lock slot to preview a craft's outcome before committing to it.
item.tumultu.rebinding_ashes.tooltip: Randomly swaps one elemental resistance affix on the item for another.
item.tumultu.empowering_gem.tooltip: Upgrades a random enchantment on the item by (1-3) levels. High rolls are extremely rare
item.tumultu.imbuing_shard.tooltip: Permanently imbues a random affix onto the item, protecting it from all further crafting. Requires at least 4 affixes.
item.tumultu.mysterious_bookpage.tooltip: Creates an exact duplicate of the item this is used on. The copy is marked Outruled and can never be duplicated again.
item.tumultu.divine_shard.tooltip: Rerolls the numeric values of a Unique item's own variable stats, if it has any. Has no effect on a Unique with no variable stats, or on any non-Unique item.
item.tumultu.cinderheart.tooltip: Fire damage dealt is multiplied by (1 + half your Fire Resistance beyond the 75% cap). This bonus is separate from and stacks multiplicatively with other fire damage bonuses.
item.tumultu.cinderheart.tooltip2: The Fire Resistance affix above only applies while this sword is held.
item.tumultu.reflection_of_iron.tooltip: Damage dealt is doubled for every 10 points of Armor you have. Deals Cobblestone Axe damage, but has Netherite durability and can be repaired with Netherite Ingots.
item.tumultu.reversed_forces.tooltip: Cancels any reduction to your Gravity from other equipped gear, converting it entirely into an equal percentage of bonus Movement Speed instead.
tumultu.bench.already_crafted: This item already has a bench-crafted modifier. Use a Cleansing Shard here to remove it.
tumultu.bench.nothing_to_remove: This item has no crafted modifier to remove.
